spec.title: Server Up
spec.description: OpenVPN server status file parses (1) or not (0).

spec.title: Keepalive Interval
spec.description: Keepalive ping interval in seconds.

spec.title: Keepalive Timeout
spec.description: Keepalive timeout in seconds.

spec.title: Client-to-Client
spec.description: 1 if client-to-client is enabled, else 0.

spec.title: Duplicate CN
spec.description: 1 if duplicate-cn is enabled, else 0.

spec.title: Persist Key
spec.description: 1 if persist-key is enabled, else 0.

spec.title: Persist TUN
spec.description: 1 if persist-tun is enabled, else 0.

spec.title: Client Bytes
spec.description: Bytes sent and received per connected client (last value in range).

spec.title: Client Bandwidth TX
spec.description: Per-client transmit (TX) rate to each connected client.

spec.title: Server Status Age
spec.description: Seconds since the server status file was last updated.

spec.title: Client Bandwidth RX
spec.description: Per-client receive (RX) rate from each connected client.

spec.title: Client Last Seen
spec.description: Seconds since the server last referenced each client route.

spec.title: Client Up
spec.description: OpenVPN client status file parses (1) or not (0).

spec.title: Client Status Age
spec.description: Seconds since the client status file was last updated.

spec.title: Auth Read Total
spec.description: Total bytes read by the client's auth layer.

spec.title: Client Info
spec.description: Static client configuration; value is always 1.

spec.title: TCP/UDP Throughput
spec.description: Underlying TCP/UDP socket traffic of the local OpenVPN client, 5m average.

spec.title: TUN/TAP Throughput
spec.description: TUN/TAP device traffic of the local OpenVPN client, 5m average.

spec.title: Compression
spec.description: Pre- and post-compression traffic of the local OpenVPN client, 5m average.

spec.title: Decompression
spec.description: Pre- and post-decompression traffic of the local OpenVPN client, 5m average.

spec.title: Connected Clients
spec.description: Clients currently connected to the OpenVPN server.

spec.title: Max Bcast/Mcast Queue
spec.description: Maximum length of the broadcast/multicast queue.

spec.title: Server Info
spec.description: Static server configuration; value is always 1.

spec.title: Server Port
spec.description: Configured listening port.

spec.title: Address Pool Size
spec.description: Number of addresses in the client ifconfig pool.

spec.title: Log Verbosity
spec.description: Configured log verbosity.

spec.title: Script Security
spec.description: Configured script-security level.
